summary: Ilkka Oyj, together with its subsidiaries, provides professional, data, and technology services for digital marketing and communications in Finland and internationally. The company operates a WordPress digital agency under the Evermade name; social media marketing agency under the MySome brand name; B2B marketing and strategic marketing under the Myynninmaailma; provides data for increasing sales under the Profinder brand name; and marketing and communications technology under the Liana and Ungapped brand names. It also offers financial, investment, human resources, development, information management, and real estate services. The company was formerly known as Ilkka-Yhtymä Oyj and changed its name to Ilkka Oyj in May 2022. Ilkka Oyj was founded in 1906 and is based in Seinäjoki, Finland.
